hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: A good subarray ending at index i must start at an element with value nums[i] - k or nums[i] + k.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: To maximize the subarray sum pref[i + 1] - pref[start], we must minimize the prefix sum pref[start] before that target value.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Maintain a hash map storing the minimum prefix sum encountered for each unique value in nums.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass prefix sum computation with hash map lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subarrays takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for prefix sum map.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Convert subarray maximization into prefix sum minimization.
